testPolicy.text: For applicants seeking to enroll in fall 2027 (2026-27 cycle), Princeton remains test optional; applying without an SAT or ACT is no disadvantage. Princeton will require the SAT or ACT again beginning with the 2027-28 cycle (fall 2028 entry), except for active military personnel.
testPolicy.since: test optional since 2020; required again for fall 2028 entry

cost.totalIncludes: tuition 68,140 + housing 13,010 + food 9,110 + fees 314 (activities fee and class dues) + books/supplies 1,050 + personal 3,000. Transportation (50 to 5,000) is not included. Student Health Plan required if not covered by a family policy (not included).

aidPromise.text: Admission is need-blind; Princeton meets 100% of demonstrated need with grant aid, and students are not required or expected to borrow. Published average family contribution for 2026-27: $0 at $150,000 income, $12,500 at $200,000, $25,000 at $250,000, $37,500 at $300,000, $50,000 at $350,000 (US families with assets under $175,000 and one child in college).

facts.text: Princeton stays test optional for fall 2027 applicants but will require the SAT or ACT from the 2027-28 cycle (fall 2028 entry), after finding that score submitters performed better academically.

New Jersey residents get no in-state edge: 229 of 4,602 in-state applicants were admitted for fall 2025 (5.0%), against 1,398 of 27,134 out-of-state (5.2%) and 241 of 10,567 international applicants (2.3%).
A typical US family earning $150,000 with assets under $175,000 has a total family contribution of $0 in 2026-27.
89% of recent seniors graduated debt free, and 71% of the Class of 2030 qualified for financial aid.
For fall 2025, 1,370 applicants were offered a waiting-list place, 1,086 accepted and 36 were admitted.

notes: ir.princeton.edu returns 403 to curl for HTML pages; the CDS link (document/606) was found through the IR CDS page in Chrome and the PDF then downloaded directly (v2 file; a v1.4 URL cited elsewhere no longer resolves). Residency rates in facts are computed from CDS C1 counts (229/4602, 1398/27134, 241/10567). No Early Decision. Class of 2030 applicant and admit counts were not published on the admission statistics page (only enrolled 1,414). CDS C8F says 'test optional through the 2026-27 cycle', consistent with the admissions page.
